snippets.output: Administering fresh frozen plasma and intravenous phytonadione (vitamin K) reverses warfarin anticoagulation; warfarin exerts its anticoagulant effect by inhibiting the production of vitamin K-dependent clotting factors, and phytonadione helps restore the normal coagulation pathway.
snippets.pattern_notes: Causal chain: warfarin inhibits vit-K factors -> phytonadione restores coagulation -> FFP/vit K reverses anticoagulation.
